answers.answer: When building an agency intake scenario in Make, I encountered a 403 Insufficient Scopes error on the Gmail module because the OAuth token lacked compose permissions. I resolved it by decoupling the signature mapping and re-authenticating with granular compose scopes.
I caught an LLM hallucinating hosting credentials during pre-sales scoping. I fixed it by enforcing a two-stage prompt taxonomy that separated raw fact extraction from scope evaluation.
Production-ready means defensive engineering: retry directives with backoff, strict JSON parsing validation, dead-letter quarantine for failures, and out-of-band alerting.
I would implement a 40-69 score review queue with automatic Slack/email alerts to the hiring team so borderline applicants with transferable CX skills are never dropped.
My most complex build was a multi-tier intake engine integrating webhooks, OpenRouter REST API, structured JSON parsing, router branching, and dual cloud persistence.
